content.short: Squid Router provides cutting-edge infrastructure for web3 bridges, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Squid Router is a cross-chain swap and liquidity routing protocol powered by the Axelar network. By leveraging the underlying security and performance of the Ethereum network(s), Squid Router aims to deliver a robust and scalable solution for its users. The project offers a suite of decentralized tools tailored for web3 bridges, ensuring transparent and trustless operations. As the Web3 landscape continues to evolve, Squid Router is positioning itself as a core infrastructure component to empower builders and end-users alike, bridging the gap between traditional architectures and decentralized networks.
content.meta: Squid Router is redefining web3 bridges on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Squid Router directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
